name: RHBBANK
recent: RHB Bank 近期成为马来西亚首家为商户提供 DuitNow Pay 受理的银行，并推出 RHB Sinar Credit Card-i。同时，公司宣布了投资者简报和股息政策计划，且雇员公积金局（EPF）在10月持续申报股权变动。
notable: 成为马来西亚首家为商户提供 DuitNow Pay 受理的银行。
推出 RHB Sinar Credit Card-i，固定利润率14%且无年费。
宣布投资者简报和股息政策计划。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在10月多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026年第二季度营收为21.56亿令吉，环比下降1.6%，同比微降0.1%；净利润为8.07亿令吉，环比下降5.8%，同比微增0.5%；净利率为37.4%，低于上一季度的39.1%。

recent_en: RHB Bank recently became the first bank in Malaysia to offer DuitNow Pay acceptance for merchants and launched the RHB Sinar Credit Card-i. Meanwhile, the company announced an investor presentation and dividend policy plan, and the Employees Provident Fund (EPF) continued to file changes in its shareholding in October.
notable_en: Became the first bank in Malaysia to offer DuitNow Pay acceptance for merchants.
Launched the RHB Sinar Credit Card-i with a 14% fixed profit rate and no annual fee.
Announced an investor presentation and dividend policy plan.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund (EPF) filed multiple changes in its shareholding in October.
earnings_en: For Q2 2026, revenue was MYR 2.156 billion, down 1.6% QoQ and 0.1% YoY; net income was MYR 807.2 million, down 5.8% QoQ but up 0.5% YoY; net margin was 37.4%, lower than 39.1% in the previous quarter.
